investigation_notes.User Role: Regional Supply Coordinator, Supply Chain & Logistics
investigation_notes.Description: An unusually large volume of SharePoint downloads (250 files vs. a 24-hour baseline of 20) was observed from the user originating in Vilnius. The activity occurred at local time 12:15 and the sample file names and paths are directly related to Supply Chain & Logistics, matching the user's role and providing a plausible business justification for bulk access. There are no recent related events or similar alerts and the user agent appears to be a standard desktop browser, so the activity is assessed as Low Priority because contextual indicators support legitimate business activity despite the spike in volume.
